text_block_list.text:
Right before the Asahi Hai F.S. starts,
Narita
Brian runs out of the tape she
always wears on her
nose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unsure which kind is the best, I buy all
of the tape
at the nearest store. Narita
Brian is shocked at my
wasteful
spending.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the huge amount is a symbol of my
faith that
she'll keep winning, no matter
who she's up
against, meaning she'll
eventually need all of that
tape.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан fixes the tape to her nose
and
focuses her attention on the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
